prompt: Seen from high above at a three-quarter angle: a straight castle wall runs across a golden wheat field. Just in front of the wall, on five separate square tiles of the grid, five small fires burn where the shards of a mortar shell came down, each tile scorched dark around its flames, with small curls of smoke. The wall itself stands unharmed. Behind the wall rise orange roofs and a square keep with a red flag. Hedges, a cart track and a few trees around. Take only the soft painterly 2D look, the colours and the light of the attached image, and paint a new picture with its own composition and its own landscape, not the river and fields of the attached image. No cannon and no gun anywhere in the picture, no smoke from a gun. Rules for the whole picture: the land carries the painted tile grid in the same perspective as the buildings, its lines parallel to the castle walls. Castle walls are straight cream stone walls along the grid, with square or round corner towers, never curved walls. Keep the bottom right corner of the picture calm: it shows only grass, trees, ground or water. Not too busy, nothing too small, and the land is not bare. No people. No text, no letters, no numbers, no title, no watermark. Soft colours, not oversaturated, not a 3D render.
